verdict.rationale: LangGraph is itself distributed as an official, first-party Python SDK (pip install langgraph) with extensive official docs covering graph API, persistence, streaming, interrupts, and multi-agent patterns, plus a CLI/Agent Server for deployment — this is the core SDK an AI-native developer builds against. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of SDK API stability/breaking-change concerns raised by community, and no evidence of official SDKs beyond Python (e.g., JS parity) in this pack.
